For each row and each column, find occurrences of the same marker color. Keep both marker endpoints unchanged, and leave any other colors unchanged. Process rows and columns independently using the original input; the output is the union of those changes. out = [row[:] for row in grid]
# marker and background are inferred from the instance/demo
for each row r:

    for x, y in consecutive_pairs(positions):
